object_context: For a smooth projective complex variety X, codimension p, and alpha in H^{2p}(X,Q) of type (p,p), identify a non-root-equivalent algebraic-generator mechanism that covers alpha by actual Chow correspondences and source classes whose algebraicity is independently known, possibly together with a complementary rational Hodge substructure proved to contain no rational Hodge classes; require an exact composition/span/assembly theorem back to alpha, and reject motivated, absolute-Hodge, categorical, or source-transfer statements that leave correspondence algebraicity, source-class algebraicity, target coverage, or the Hodge-empty complement open.
structural_coordinates: the rational Hodge root is equivalently a lifting problem for Hodge morphisms Q(-p)->H^{2p}(X,Q)
composition and push-pull of actual algebraic correspondences preserve algebraic-cycle authority when codimension/degree bookkeeping is correct
a source correspondence helps only when the source class is already algebraic at the required degree; otherwise the root difficulty is relocated
a generator strategy requires a coverage theorem proving alpha lies in the span/composition closure of certified algebraic generators
discarding a complementary Hodge summand requires an exact proof that it contains no rational Hodge classes
projectors or inverse operations used in the decomposition must be algebraic at Chow authority; motivated/Hodge/numerical/categorical projectors do not automatically suffice
Buskin and Markman algebraize restrictive Hodge-isometry classes using K3/hyperkahler geometry, not arbitrary Hodge classes
coefficients remain Q and all smooth/projective/complex hypotheses remain explicit
equivalent_formulations: construct Z in CH^p(X)_Q with cl_Q(Z)=alpha through a span/composition of source-certified algebraic correspondences
express Q(-p)->H^{2p}(X,Q) in a generator closure whose elementary morphisms have Chow realizations and whose closure law preserves algebraicity
decompose Hdg^p(X) as an algebraic-correspondence-generated subspace plus a rational Hodge complement with zero rational Hodge classes, with an exact assembly theorem
solved_analogues: Buskin: every rational Hodge isometry between projective K3 surfaces is algebraic
Markman: rational Hodge isometries of H^2 for projective hyper-Kahler varieties of K3[n]-type are induced by algebraic correspondences
Lefschetz (1,1): divisors realize rational Hodge classes in codimension one
near_solved_analogues: Patel-Zhang: geometric class-field-theory constructions yield algebraic representatives for specified Weil Hodge classes on some generalized Prym varieties
Kamenova-Kumar: known hyperkahler varieties with sufficiently large Picard number admit algebraic correspondences to abelian varieties, but source-side Hodge algebraicity still must be discharged
Deligne: Hodge cycles on abelian varieties are absolute Hodge, supplying rigidity but not a general Chow representative
Andre motivated motives: motivated correspondences give an unconditional enlarged correspondence category with strong realization properties, but motivated is not automatically Chow-algebraic

method_transfers.source_context: Buskin rational Hodge isometries of projective K3 surfaces
method_transfers.method: reduce a restricted Hodge-morphism class to geometrically realizable correspondence steps and compose source-certified algebraic correspondences
shared_structure: a target Hodge morphism lies in a closure generated by elementary source-realizable morphisms
composition of algebraic correspondences preserves algebraic authority
required_assumptions: the target morphism is a rational Hodge isometry of H^2 for K3 surfaces
the K3/moduli/coherent-sheaf geometry used in the proof is available
disanalogies: an arbitrary Hodge class Q(-p)->H^{2p}(X,Q) is not an H^2 isometry and has no known generator theorem
higher codimension and arbitrary varieties lack the same lattice/Torelli structure
method_transfers.repair_question: Is there a broader class of Hodge morphisms/classes admitting a proved finite generator theorem by elementary morphisms whose Chow correspondences are independently algebraic?
source_anchors: Nikolay Buskin, arXiv:1510.02852; J. Reine Angew. Math. 755 (2019)

method_transfers.method: realize H^2 Hodge isometries by coherent-sheaf/analytic correspondences and obtain algebraic correspondences in the projective case
shared_structure: actual geometric correspondences realize a restricted Hodge-morphism class
projectivity upgrades the relevant correspondence classes to algebraic cycles
required_assumptions: H^2 rational Hodge isometry for the Beauville-Bogomolov-Fujiki form
disanalogies: the root asks for arbitrary rational Hodge classes in every even degree/codimension
the hyperkahler monodromy/moduli apparatus is absent for general X
method_transfers.repair_question: Which exact correspondence generators survive outside the H^2-isometry setting, and can their image cover a nontrivial new Hodge subspace without assuming Hodge?

method_transfers.method: use abelian-cover, Abel-Jacobi and Prym geometry to construct explicit algebraic cycles spanning specified Weil-Hodge subspaces
shared_structure: a geometric mechanism produces source cycles before target algebraicity
the target Hodge subspace is explicitly identified and matched to generated algebraic classes
required_assumptions: the exact representation-theoretic decomposition and maps used in the construction
disanalogies: the construction covers specified Hodge subspaces in special abelian varieties rather than arbitrary Hdg^p(X)
curve/Jacobian/Prym geometry has no known general analogue
method_transfers.repair_question: Can the source-generator principle be abstracted to a materially broader class without losing exact target coverage?
source_anchors: Deepam Patel and Yilong Zhang, arXiv:2506.13729, manuscript dated 2026-05-22

method_transfers.source_context: Andre motivated motives and Deligne absolute Hodge cycles

explicit_disanalogies: algebraicity of restricted Hodge isometries does not imply algebraicity of arbitrary Hodge morphisms
an algebraic correspondence Y x X does not solve the target root if the required source Hodge class on Y is not already known algebraic
correspondence to an abelian variety may move the root obligation to the source rather than discharge it
absolute Hodge, motivated, numerical, and categorical classes are not synonyms for Chow cycle classes
a Hodge-theoretic decomposition is not source-bearing unless its projectors/assembly maps have the required algebraic authority
genericity/dimension heuristics do not prove a complementary rational Hodge structure has zero rational Hodge classes
integral/generalized/Tate variants remain contrastive evidence only

cross_domain_analogies.source_situation: A complex transformation inherits certification from elementary instructions only when every instruction has a verified implementation, composition preserves certification, and a coverage theorem proves the requested transformation lies in the generated instruction set.
common_abstraction: explicit residual outside the generated closure
source_to_target_mapping: verified instruction -> algebraic correspondence with independently algebraic source class
coverage theorem -> proof alpha lies in generated Hodge subspace
residual -> Hodge complement requiring zero-Hodge proof or new generator
shared_constraints: certified generators alone are insufficient without target coverage
a residual outside the closure cannot be silently discarded
disanalogies: correspondence composition carries codimension/Kunneth/degree constraints absent from instruction sets
Hodge structures have tensor/polarization and geometric-realization constraints absent from software semantics
cross_domain_analogies.proposed_principle: Search for a theorem-backed algebraic generator system plus a target-coverage theorem rather than stronger target labels; audit source algebraicity and any Hodge-empty complement separately.
cross_domain_analogies.validation_obligation: Specify every algebraic correspondence and source class, prove closure under used operations, prove alpha lies in the generated image, and either source-realize or prove Hodge-empty every complementary component.
cross_domain_analogies.provenance_note: Proposal-organizing analogy only; creates no mathematical authority.

analogy_scan_notes: Scanned generator/closure systems, K3 and hyperkahler isometry algebraization, Prym cycle constructions, motivated/absolute-Hodge categories, source transfers to abelian varieties, and Hodge-empty complements. Retained only certified-generator plus coverage.
